description: wiki_search – FamilySearch Wiki search for Christ Church Philadelphia records. No specific Christ Church page exists on the FS Wiki; the top result is the Pennsylvania Church Records article.

results.chunk_text: Pennsylvania has significant church records for many denominations dating to the colonial period. For Episcopal/Anglican churches, active congregations keep their own registers; the Diocese of Pennsylvania holds records for closed Episcopal churches in Philadelphia county. The Historical Society of Pennsylvania holds collections described as abstracts taken from various Pennsylvania church records.
